assertions.name: reading_a_closes_gap_below_1e_minus_4
assertions.source: Reading-A (5/2 − G·h²) substitution to Family A closes the m_p-anchored target gap to less than 1e-4 in linking_weight units at q_0, mp.mpf 50 dps. This corresponds to < ~0.04 ppm in m_p — far below PR #1272's claimed '8% h⁴+ tower' (which would be ~5e-3 in lw, ~2400 ppm in m_p).

description: mp.mpf 50-dps measurement of Reading-A (5/2 − G·h²) residual against the m_p-anchored target linking_weight. Finds residual ≈ 1.38e-5 (≈ 0.3 ppm in m_p) — closes 99.98% of the Family A gap, vs PR #1272's claim of 92%. Reconciles with PR #1272 by noting their 'via_jones' is a DIFFERENT mathematical object from target_lw.

pr_1272_reconciliation.interpretation: PR #1272's 'via_jones' (2.5269 at q_0) is NOT the m_p-anchored target_lw (2.4599 at q_0). The 8% they attribute to 'h⁴+ tower' is actually (Family A − via_jones) = 0.0059, which is structurally distinct from the (Reading-A − target_lw) gap = 1.4e-5.
